target.title: fix(feishu): preserve text before media attachments
target.body:
Closes #102390

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Feishu users would lose the assistant's visible text when a final reply contained both prose and a `MEDIA:` image attachment while streaming cards were active. The affected chat could show only the no-visible-reply fallback or an attachment without the intended explanation.

## Why This Change Was Made

The Feishu reply dispatcher now closes the final streaming text card before sending regular media attachments, so the text is committed as visible content before the attachment path runs. If the streaming close accepts no text content, the dispatcher falls back to a normal text reply before sending media; voice-media duplicate-text suppression stays on the existing path.

A real Feishu repro showed one more gap: dispatcher-backed streaming block replies were being treated as delivered as soon as they were queued. If the async channel delivery later failed, the block pipeline could still dedupe the final answer and leave the turn with no visible reply. The core reply path now waits for the dispatcher-backed block delivery to settle when streaming callers need an acknowledgement, and the block pipeline aborts on delivery errors so the final payload remains available as fallback.

## User Impact

Feishu replies that combine a text body with an image attachment now preserve both parts of the answer. If streaming block delivery fails, OpenClaw keeps the final reply instead of silently deduping it away and showing the no-visible-reply fallback.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/auto-reply/reply/block-reply-pipeline.test.ts src/auto-reply/reply/dispatch-from-config.test.ts extensions/feishu/src/reply-dispatcher.test.ts`
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/auto-reply/reply/agent-runner-payloads.test.ts`
- `git diff --check`
- `pnpm openclaw gateway --force` reached `[gateway] ready` with Feishu WebSocket ready on the patched local build; no second live inbound proof was received before shutdown.
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode branch --base upstream/main` (`autoreview clean: no accepted/actionable findings reported`)
